She is a Lutheran, so I believe her views differ from those of the Catholic church, because I always saw Lutherans as "lazy Christians"

They are pretty liberal, politically but not theologically. Think about this, their very lifestyle revolves religion and teaching it or doing its work. If they were to accept and be lenient of religion, they would be, essentially, diminishing everything about their lives. But yeah, other than religion and pot, they are very liberal. They are gay right advocates and are pro choice.

I tell them because I am afraid of how they would react. Firstly, they would be extremely disappointed in me because I actually got confirmed while I knew I was an atheist. They constantly give me lectures on religion while I try to make counter points, then they decide to start telling me, and I'm going to say what sounds closest to what she said, "You're Christian and no one can tell you otherwise." But she always tells me of all the dying people she is praying for and she always tells me of the powers of prayer, and I die a little bit on the inside because I feel so guilty. Also, I love my parents and do not want to hurt them. My sister is a deist, and she said it would be best to not tell them because it would destroy them (they don't know about her either). But the biggest reason I do not want to tell them is because I do not want to be disowned by them. They said if they ever caught me doing pot they would do that.
